title: let the Tests line say that the gate relied on ork's round results instead of forcing 0 passed 0 failed

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-152522-c419, project ork, item S394:

let the Tests line say that the gate relied on ork's round results instead of forcing 0 passed 0 failed

Evidence: the gate is told not to run the suite but must still print Tests: N passed, M failed with the counts of its own run
